This report compares machine learning (ML) force fields against density functional theory (DFT) anharmonic calculations for IR spectroscopy. All spectra include anharmonic fundamentals, overtones, and combination bands. Broadening was applied using Gaussian convolution with 8 cm^-1 FWHM.
